name: dx
description: Skills and CLIs for running coding agents in tmux and git worktrees: session lifecycle, parallel worktrees, tmux, memory, Codex, review and more

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Park idle Claude Code sessions in tmux to free memory and resume them with one keypress (cc-park), and hand a long session off to a fresh one through a written brief (fresh-session-handoff)

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Run N Claude Code or Codex sessions in parallel git worktrees with a merged log (parallel-worktrees), contract-first fan-outs (contract-fanout), and branch stacking (stack-branches, stack-claude)

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Snapshot every tmux pane with links to its agent and transcript (tmux-archive), and rename and regroup windows from their contents through a reviewed plan (tmux-organize)

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: End-of-session retrospectives that capture learnings and open follow-ups (reflect), nightly memory consolidation (dreaming), and transcript analysis (session-analyzer)

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Fan out Codex CLI subagents through tmux (codex-subagents) and read a Codex agent's real transcript instead of its truncated pane (codex-transcripts)

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Code review by Codex, Claude and other engines with a pre-send secret scan (autoreview), multi-lens review with three refuters per finding (adversarial-review), a canary harness for MCP servers that touch secrets (mcp-agent-safety), and a tmux-side second-opinion advisor (fable-second-opinion)

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Free disk space on a Mac or Linux dev host without touching active work, from a bounded read-only survey (disk-reclaim), and find open GitLab issues whose work already merged (shipped-but-open)

plugins.name: music-video
plugins.description: Make an original song and a music video for it end to end: lyrics, generated song takes picked by fidelity, word-timed kinetic typography and three.js 3D rendered frame by frame, a mastered mix and social cuts (music-video)
